Performance of a classical piece for the guqin, or just qin, the seven string chinese zither. The english title for this piece is "Autumn wind poem". This tune can also be sung. The lyrics contain a poem by Li Bo, a Tang poet, which is titled "Three, five, seven words".

author: Lo Ka Ping
description: Arbiter Records brings you an excerpt from one of their latest world music albums. Guqin master Lo Ka Ping performs the traditional piece Teals Descending On The Level Sand. Recorded circa 1970. Other guqin artists on the album include Zheng Yingsun and Xu Yuan Bay. The whole album can be purchased
